rules.statement: The environment shall release i_rst_n synchronously to i_clk.
Assertion of i_rst_n may be asynchronous.
The environment shall keep i_cmd_valid = 0 while i_rst_n = 0.
The environment shall change i_cpol and i_cpha only while o_cs_n = 1.
Error tests may deliberately violate the rule that i_cpol and i_cpha change only while o_cs_n = 1.
The SPI slave testbench model shall drive i_miso as a function of o_sclk and o_cs_n only.
The slave shall put bit 7 on i_miso when o_cs_n falls and the next bit after each trailing SCLK edge.
The slave shall put bit 7 − j on i_miso after leading SCLK edge 2·j + 1.
The slave model shall change i_miso only after the i_clk edge at which o_sclk or o_cs_n changed, never altering the value seen at a sampling edge.
The environment shall not assert i_rst_n at an i_clk edge; assertion happens between edges.

rules.condition: i_rst_n assertion coincides with a clock edge
rules.statement: An edge coinciding with i_rst_n assertion is not a legal case and no check covers it.
The environment shall drive i_rst_n = 0 from time zero, before the first rising i_clk edge, for at least 2 cycles.
i_cpol, i_cpha and every other input shall always be 0 or 1, never X or Z.

rules.condition: before the first assertion of i_rst_n
rules.statement: Outputs are undefined and no check applies before the first assertion of i_rst_n.

rules.condition: in silicon, at each sampling edge
rules.statement: i_miso shall meet setup and hold time to i_clk at each sampling edge; with D = 1, slave clock-to-output plus board round trip must fit in one period minus setup.
The command stream may change i_cmd_valid, i_cmd_data and i_cmd_last before acceptance; stability is not required.
The response consumer may drive i_rsp_ready with any pattern.
Verification shall run all four modes in every configuration of section 11, with random bytes on i_cmd_data and from the slave model.
Verification shall use burst lengths 1, 2 and at least 16, mixing bursts with and without pauses (i_cmd_valid gaps of 0, 1 and many cycles).
A scoreboard shall check each response equals the byte sent by the slave during the matching command, in order, with no loss or duplicate.
A slave-side monitor shall check MOSI data at every sampling edge and the SCLK edge times (A + k·D).
The monitor shall also check lead, trail and gap times, the SCLK idle level and that o_mosi never changes at a sampling edge.
Verification shall check o_cmd_ready cycle by cycle against REQ-CMD-006 to REQ-CMD-012, including the blocked first D − 1 Idle cycles.
Back-pressure tests shall hold i_rsp_ready = 0 for long periods so that a held byte is created.
Back-pressure tests shall cover a response handshake exactly at edge A + 16·D (REQ-ERR-009) and random i_rsp_ready patterns.
Reset tests shall hold i_rsp_ready = 0 before reset where a shown or held byte is wanted, and assert i_rst_n between i_clk edges in each phase (Transfer, Pause, Trail, Idle gap, held byte).
Reset tests shall check that outputs take reset values at once and no response of the aborted transfer appears.
A test shall toggle i_cpol while i_rst_n = 0 and in Idle, and check o_sclk follows it in the same cycle.
A test shall change i_cpol and i_cpha in the cycle just before a burst-start acceptance edge and check the new values are used.
An error test shall change i_cpol and i_cpha during a burst and check the burst finishes in the captured mode.
Coverage shall include mode × configuration, continuous join, pause entry and exit, held byte created and released, reset in each phase, and i_cmd_last = 1 on the first byte.
REQ-PAR-001 shall be checked by elaborating once with an illegal value, not by simulation.
